records.title: Routes under UDAN Scheme.
details: a to c:) The Government has announced the launch of the modified UDAN Scheme to increase regional connectivity to 120 new destinations across the country, to cater to 4 crore passengers over the next 10 years. The scheme will also support helipads and smaller airports in hilly, aspirational, and North East region districts. The scheme is presently at the approval stage.

records.title: Vande Bharat Express Trains
details: The Hon'ble MP has requested for a Vande Bharat Train from Ahemdabad to Somnth, I have taken note of it and after chekcing its feasibility, I will provide the details to the Hon'ble MP.

records.title: Lack of Banking Facilities in Rural Areas
details: a to f: Efforts are being undertaken to cover these remaining villages also by suitable banking outlets, status of which is reviewed at a periodical level.
